title: CmdPal: When navigating back to home, retain search text

proposed_comments.title: Qualify when the search is cleared

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream event handler invokes HandleGoHome, whose KeepPreviousQuery guard conditionally skips ClearSearch.

proposed_comments.body:
### Qualify when the search is cleared

**Severity:** `low`

`HandleGoHome()` leaves the query intact when `KeepPreviousQuery` is enabled, so this comment currently describes clearing as unconditional. Could we qualify it?

```suggestion
    // The navigation request clears the search unless KeepPreviousQuery is enabled.
```
